name: take_along_dim_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::take_along_dim.out(Tensor self, Tensor indices, int? dim=None, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Tests cover the full real dtype set, positive/negative/None dimensions, broadcast shapes, exact out identity, saved storage and stride for correct and noncontiguous outputs, empty-buffer resize, and dtype rejection.
